title: Cosmic Sorcerers and Octopus Oracle
description: Three wizards with long beards and ornate robes stand around a large glowing crystal ball containing a pink octopus-like creature with a single yellow eye, while a smaller crystal ball below shows the same three figures. A large cracked moon with a face and constellation symbols floats in the starry cosmic background with swirling galaxies and glowing pillars.
prompt: Three long-bearded wizards in ornate colorful robes stand on a cosmic platform, one with pink beard and fur trim, one with green dripping beard and tall hat, one with blue and pink robes, all holding strings connected to a large glowing crystal sphere containing a vibrant pink octopus creature with one large yellow eye and lightning, below it a smaller crystal ball reflecting the three wizards, background features a giant cracked moon with a human-like face, constellations, swirling purple galaxies, glowing spotlights and ancient pillars in a dark starry void
